categories.title: Getting Started
categories.description: Learn the basics of using TeybatDriver

sections.content: Your account needs to be verified before you can start accepting orders. This ensures the safety and quality of our driver network.

items: Complete your driver registration with accurate information
Upload required documents (ID, driver's license, vehicle registration)
Wait 24-48 hours for our team to review your application
Receive a notification when your account is approved

sections.content: While waiting for verification, you can take the interactive tour to learn how the app works!
Once your account is verified, you can go online to start receiving delivery requests.

items: Ensure your account is verified (green checkmark on profile)
Enable location services on your device
Tap the 'Go Online' toggle on the home screen
You'll start receiving order notifications

sections.content: You must keep location services enabled while online so customers can track their deliveries.

articles.title: Your First Delivery
articles.description: Step-by-step guide for your first order

sections.content: Congratulations on your first delivery! Here's what to expect:

items: Go online and wait for an order notification
Review the order details (pickup, dropoff, payment)
Accept the order within 30 seconds
Navigate to the pickup location
Collect the items and verify the order
Navigate to the customer's location
Complete the delivery and mark as delivered
Receive your earnings!

sections.content: Take your time with your first few deliveries. Customer ratings improve with experience!

categories.title: Managing Orders
categories.description: Everything about accepting and completing orders

sections.content: When you're online, you'll receive notifications for new orders that match your location and vehicle type.

items: Review the order card showing pickup, dropoff, distance, and earnings
Check if the route fits your current location
Tap 'Accept' within 30 seconds
Start navigating to the pickup location

sections.content: Orders that aren't accepted within 30 seconds will be offered to other drivers. Your acceptance rate affects your priority for future orders.

articles.title: Using Navigation
articles.description: Navigate to pickup and delivery locations

sections.content: TeybatDriver includes built-in turn-by-turn navigation to help you reach your destinations quickly.

items: Tap the 'Navigate' button on the order details screen
Choose between in-app navigation or Google Maps
Follow the directions to reach the pickup location
After pickup, navigate to the customer's dropoff location
Update the order status at each step

sections.content: The in-app navigation works offline with downloaded maps. Use Google Maps for real-time traffic updates.
Each order progresses through several statuses as you complete the delivery:

items: PENDING - Order is waiting for you to accept
ACCEPTED - You've accepted and are heading to pickup
ON_THE_WAY - You've collected items and are delivering
DELIVERED - You've arrived and handed over the delivery
COMPLETED - Delivery is confirmed complete

sections.content: You must update the status manually at each step by tapping the status button on the order details screen.

articles.title: Completing Deliveries
articles.description: Final steps to complete an order

sections.content: When you arrive at the customer's location, follow these steps:

items: Mark status as 'Arrived' when you reach the location
Contact the customer if needed using the call button
Hand over the delivery and verify any special instructions
Tap 'Mark as Delivered' to confirm
Your earnings will be credited to your account

sections.content: Always be courteous and professional. Good customer service leads to better ratings and tips!
You earn money for each completed delivery. Your earnings consist of:

items: Base delivery fee (varies by distance and demand)
Customer tips (100% goes to you)
Bonuses during peak hours and special promotions

sections.content: You can track your daily, weekly, and monthly earnings in the Earnings tab.
Payments are processed automatically on a regular schedule:

items: Earnings are calculated at the end of each week
Payments are processed every Monday
Funds are deposited to your registered bank account within 2-3 business days
You'll receive a notification when payment is processed

sections.content: Make sure your bank details are up to date in your profile to avoid payment delays.
Tips are a significant part of your earnings. Here's how to maximize them:

items: Provide excellent customer service
Communicate with customers if there are delays
Handle food items carefully to maintain quality
Be professional and courteous
Deliver within the estimated time

sections.content: Bonuses are available during peak hours (lunch, dinner) and in high-demand areas. Check the app for current promotions.
If you're having trouble with location services:

items: Ensure location services are enabled in your device settings
Grant TeybatDriver permission to access location 'Always' or 'While Using App'
Check that you have a clear view of the sky (GPS works best outdoors)
Restart the app if location isn't updating
Toggle airplane mode on and off to reset GPS

sections.content: You must have location enabled to go online and receive orders.
If the app is not functioning properly:

items: Check your internet connection (WiFi or mobile data)
Force close the app and reopen it
Clear the app cache in device settings
Update to the latest version from the app store
Restart your device
Uninstall and reinstall the app as a last resort

sections.content: Your order history and earnings data are stored on our servers, so reinstalling won't cause data loss.
